company.name: Ambience Healthcare
company.shortDescription: Ambience Healthcare develops an AI operating system used for documentation, coding, and clinical workflows in healthcare organizations.
company.description: Ambience Healthcare develops an AI operating system used for documentation, coding, and clinical workflows in healthcare settings. The company builds an AI medical scribe that captures clinician-patient conversations in real time and converts them into clinical notes. Its scribe tool includes speech recognition, real-time documentation, and AI features designed to integrate with electronic medical record systems. The tool generates notes within seconds and allows customization based on user preferences.
